FAR_TRANS.TRANSACTIONS.purpose: Records all buy and sell transactions of financial assets by customers across different channels and markets.

FAR_TRANS.CLOSE_PRICES.purpose: Stores daily closing prices for financial assets identified by ISIN over time.
FAR_TRANS.CLOSE_PRICES.grain: one row per asset per day

FAR_TRANS.CUSTOMER_INFORMATION.purpose: Tracks customer profile attributes including type, risk level, and investment capacity over time.
FAR_TRANS.CUSTOMER_INFORMATION.grain: one row per customer per profile change date

FAR_TRANS.V_CUSTOMER_CURRENT.purpose: Stores the current state of customer profiles including risk assessment and investment capacity.

FAR_TRANS.LIMIT_PRICES.purpose: Stores minimum and maximum price points for assets over their trading period with profitability calculations.

FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION.purpose: Stores master reference data for financial assets including classification and market details.

FAR_TRANS.V_ASSET_CURRENT.purpose: Stores current state of financial assets including stocks, bonds, ETFs, and mutual funds with their categorization and market information.
FAR_TRANS.V_ASSET_CURRENT.grain: one row per asset (ISIN) at current state

FAR_TRANS.MARKETS.purpose: Stores reference data for financial exchanges and markets including trading schedules and geographic location.
FAR_TRANS.MARKETS.grain: one row per market or exchange
